title: The request to start an experiment

sandboxVersion.description: The id of an image version (protocol/sandbox/v1 version), or the newest version that is ready.

trials.description: The trials for each case. Absent: the trials of each eval (3 unless the eval sets another).

params.description: The parameter values that each run gets: a flat object of the parameters that ratel.yaml declares.

label.description: Run only the approved cases with this label.

evals.description: The names of the evals to run, from 1 to 100. Absent: the suite, each eval of the project. An unknown name is refused with not_found (404).
